title: Fork identity, presentation identity, and rollback
objective: Keep fork operations target-local while preserving the source's immutable historical presentation and interaction controls.
requirements: Remap operational session/observation/work IDs and retain immutable presentation labels.
Restore checkpointed aggregates and activity action surfaces without re-running newer display policy.
Copy evidence, reject stale picker snapshots, and remove every pre-terminal half-fork.
Define logical display paths separately from target physical artifact paths.
acceptance: expanded evidence and activity fork frames are Cell-identical
target operations resolve remapped IDs and copied evidence
corrupt checkpoint leaves no discoverable half-fork
result: Fork operational IDs are target-local while historical presentation labels, exact aggregate/action surfaces, evidence bytes, Cells, and group controls remain identical.
remaining_risks: A future path action must introduce an explicit logical-display/physical-artifact path type.
Two independent processes editing one session require a repository writer lease.
